about.title: About Ask Algeria
about.lead: One front door to Algerian public-service information. You ask in your own words; we find the official page that answers it.

sections.title: How it works
body: We regularly read official Algerian government websites, mostly .gov.dz and .dz domains, including the PDF guides and forms they publish.
When you ask a question, the system searches that collection in French, Arabic and English and picks the most relevant passages.

Your first answer is free search: the matching lines of those pages, quoted with their source. If you ask for a written answer, an AI model writes it using only those passages, and every fact links to the page it came from.
If the official pages we have don't cover your question, the answer says so and points you to the most relevant official site.

sections.title: This is not a government website
body: Ask Algeria is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or operated by the Government of Algeria or any ministry, wilaya or public body.
We can't submit applications, book appointments or look up your personal records.
We don't give legal, tax, medical or financial advice.
Procedures, fees and deadlines change. Always confirm on the official page before you act.

sections.title: Your privacy
body: Before your question is sent, your browser removes ID, phone, card and account numbers and emails. Names, addresses and dates are not removed, so leave them out.

We don't keep your conversations. If you rate an answer, we save that question, up to 3 earlier questions, the start of the answer and your comment (personal numbers removed) to improve answers. Messages sent through Contact us are kept so we can read them, with your email only if you give one. They are also emailed to our support inbox.
Written answers are kept for 24 hours, not linked to you, so the same question is answered faster next time.
Documents you upload are sent to our AI provider (Anthropic) to produce your result. We don't store them. Numbers inside an uploaded file are not removed.

If you use the microphone button, your browser turns your voice into text with its own speech service (Google in Chrome, Apple in Safari). We never receive the audio, only the text you then choose to send.

To limit abuse we count requests per connection for 2 days, using a scrambled (hashed) form of your IP address. Your language, your office and, if you choose, your Prepare my file details stay in your browser.

sections.title: Neutrality
body: Answers describe official procedures only. We don't take positions on parties, candidates or political questions. For elections, we only explain how to register and vote according to official sources.

prepare.sub: Pick a procedure, type your details once, and get a printable packet: a checklist from official pages, a cover letter, a details sheet to copy onto the official form, and the official links.

prepare.privacy: Nothing you type on this page is sent to us or to anyone. The documents are built in your browser. Nothing is saved unless you tick “Remember on this device”, and you can erase it at any time.

what.title: What this page does
what.body: Getting an official document usually means gathering several papers. This page helps you collect and organise everything your request needs, in one place.
steps: Choose where you live (inside or outside Algeria) and the document you need.
Type your details once. They stay on your device.
Print or download your file: the list of documents from official pages, a cover letter, a sheet with your details to copy onto the official form, and the official links.
